name: Land 13:25 + car handover (TIA)
description: Ryanair FR 6890 lands 13:25. Car: Ford Puma automatic, Lets Drive, 12 Sep 13:30 -> 19 Sep 13:30. Handover at an airport hotel, not the terminal - budget 40 min. 189.17 paid, 69.47 due at the desk, deposit 600, excess 1,200. On landing: eSIM on, set as the data line, data roaming ON for it, lifecell data OFF.

name: Spar, Lezhe - fire food, Sunday breakfast, cash
description: For the fire tonight and breakfast tomorrow: sausages (no prep, no pan); chicken thighs or pork neck already cut; veg that survives a fire - corn on the cob, peppers, courgette, onion, potatoes in foil; FOIL; bread, tomatoes, cucumber, feta, olives, olive oil; CHARCOAL + FIRELIGHTERS (driftwood is thin and damp); water 6+ L; beer or wine; eggs, bread, coffee or tea. CASH FROM THE ATM HERE.

name: Beach camp, Shengjin - pitch north of Kult
description: Free wild camp on the sand, inside the Buna River - Velipoje protected landscape (normal recreational use allowed; nothing found that bans a fire, nothing confirms one is normal). Pitch first, then walk - take wallets and phones with you. WALK THE SAND BEFORE YOU DRIVE IT: front-wheel drive, EUR 1,200 excess; the track in is OSM surface=sand, smoothness=horrible, though photos show ordinary cars on it. Too soft -> Bar Ledh 1.8 km, Kult 1.5 km, or the hard car park (backup pins). Fire: look at the scrub before you light anything - 28 C after dry days; wrong-looking, cook on gas. All three forecast models say rain tonight (7-29 mm).
communityNotes: Sand track in: OSM highway=service, surface=sand, tracktype=grade5. The glamping host above says normal cars cannot reach and sells a 4x4 shuttle - interested party.
facilities: none - shower, drink and food at Kult 1.5 km down the beach

name: Rana e Hedhun dune - swim, climb it, sunset
description: The 'thrown sand' dune where the Renci mountain drops into the bay. Walk along the beach from camp, swim, climb the dune, stay for sunset 18:58 - headlamps for the walk back, dark 19:25. Pin is the Wikidata point for the dune: it sits between the camp pin and Kult, not 1.7 km north-west as the plan said - you will see it from the sand either way. Snorkel mask: the rocky headland Maja e Zeze north of camp drops to 2-3 m over rock.

name: Kult beach bar - shower, drink, food
description: The bar the camp sits north of. Shower, a drink and food; fresh fish off the local boats around Shengjin. Then back to camp for the fire.

name: Bar Ledh - fallback if the sand is too soft
description: 1.8 km from the camp pin. Park here and walk if the sand track is too soft for the Puma.

name: Hard car park - fallback if the sand is too soft
description: Hard standing near the beach. Park here and carry the kit onto the sand if the track is too soft.

name: Kune-Vain-Tale reserve - lookout tower, jetty, kayak hire (lead only)
description: ~20 min detour from the beach camp. One travel blog mentions a lookout tower, a jetty and kayak / speedboat hire; no operator, price or opening hours found. A lead, not a plan.

name: Lezhe Castle - delta view, 1.5 km from the Spar
description: Illyrian-Venetian-Ottoman hilltop castle above Lezhe, a short drive up from town. Only if the landing runs early - the dune at sunset is the plan. Location from OSM; not checked for hours or a fee.

name: Mesi Bridge (Ura e Mesit)
description: Ottoman, 1770s, 13 arches over the Kir. A 15 min stop, not a destination. Turn left at the fork in Mesi onto Rruga Mesit Postribe for the canyon.

name: Kir canyon - three pools (Prekal road)
description: Free, walk-up, paved road the whole 8 km. Pool One: car park 200 lek, 5 min walk, the busy one, deep, wooden bridge in. Pool Two: layby for two cars, 1 min, quiet, shallow entry then deep immediately. Pool Three: free, marked as a campsite, best pool 100 m upstream - the jump rock locals use. DEPTH-CHECK EVERY JUMP YOURSELF: levels change and 2026 is a drought year. Water shoes - broken glass found at Pool Three. Leave the rod in the car, the canyon is close to fishless. Pin is on the canyon road about 5 km before Prekal (17 km / 26 min from Mesi Bridge); the three pools are along this stretch of road, the cave is at the village.

name: Zhyle cave, Prekal - torch, ice-cold pool
description: At Prekal village, own car park, easy scramble in. Pool inside above waist height, ice cold. Bring a torch. Prekal Park bar next door. No phone signal this far up the canyon.

name: Butcher (Shpija e Mishit) - qofte, lamb
description: Bulevardi Skenderbeu 54, in the bazaar cluster. Qofte and lamb are the grill buy here. Buy on the way back, not in the morning - meat should not sit in a hot car all day. It is Sunday: if shut, any Shkoder supermarket meat counter does the job (Spar 07:00-22:00, 200 m east).

name: Tiny House Shiroka - hot tub, BBQ, the evening
description: BOOKED 2026-08-30, EUR 116, Sun 13 -> Mon 14. The Airbnb pin is approximate - the exact spot is in the booking. No check-in to wait for, the house is yours whenever - you come here once, at the end of the day (the morning detour via Shiroka was cut: it cost an hour). From ~17:30: hot tub, BBQ with the butcher's qofte and lamb, cards and dice (Durak, Gin Rummy, Cribbage), music offline, wine or raki from a shop not a bar. Tani Mini-Market 08:00-20:00 for anything missed, ATM beside it.
facilities: hot tub (gas ~EUR 20 if run all night), BBQ

name: Shiroka promenade - FISH at dusk (perch)
description: Perch on a small streamer, straight off the house's doorstep. A confirmed species (peer-reviewed survey) - nobody has confirmed catching one on a fly here. 30-60 min, no travel. Drini Times SUP / kayak hire is in Shiroka: walk past, see if they hand you a board; flat lake, low priority, no loss if shut.

name: Shiroka lakeside restaurants - tave krapi (baked lake carp)
description: Bar Restaurant Shiroka, Shkodra Lake Restaurant or Sunset Restaurant. A main plus salad and a drink 1,000-1,200 lek. Only if the BBQ falls through.

name: Marubi photo museum, Shkoder - if early
description: 150 years of the Marubi studio's glass negatives - the best museum in the north, about an hour. OSM says 09:00-19:00 (day pattern not tagged; Monday closure not checked). 400 m from Conad, so it also fits Monday's 85 minutes if the shops go fast.

name: Syri i Sheganit - Shkoder's swimmable Blue Eye, 20 min off the Theth road
description: A karst spring on the lake's north shore you can actually swim in - the northern cousin of the famous Blue Eye. On SH1 north of Koplik: from the Theth turn-off at Koplik it is ~8 km further north, so a 20 min detour each way on Monday, or a Sunday-evening swim from Shiroka (~45 min). Last 800 m unsealed but fine for any car; park by the wetlands sign (room for two cars) or two minutes on at the restaurant. Source: walkmyworld.com, read Sat 12 Sep - one traveller's page; location from OSM. Not in the plan - Monday has no slack; only if something drops.

name: Stolia Coffeehouse - coffee, re-check the forecast on wifi
description: Coffee, and the forecast on wifi. Thu 17 at the 2,206 m camp is the day to plan around - cold and wet on 2 of 3 models on Fri 11. Decide the high camp here (see the high camp pin).

name: Te tullat e Kuqe - cafe, 07:00-24:00
description: The other coffee, 250 m west. Same job: wifi and the forecast.

name: Outdoor shop - gas canister, try first
description: Screw-top gas canister for the stove - flights ban it, so it is bought here. NONE of the shops is confirmed to stock it; try in this order, all within 700 m. Fallback: the Store and Go 24/7 locker, EUR 12 - their site sells the canister online with 'Pick-Up at Facility'; ordered the night before, the shop hunt becomes the fallback instead of the plan.

name: Riparime Paisje GAZI - gas shop, second try
description: Screw-top gas canister for the stove - flights ban it, so it is bought here. NONE of the shops is confirmed to stock it; try in this order, all within 700 m. name: Store and Go locker 24/7 - canister EUR 12
description: Rruga Studenti 10 (pin is the street, not the door). Automated lockers, open 00:00-23:59; Camping Gas 500 g screw-top EUR 12, order online with 'Pick-Up at Facility' (their site says a saved delivery address blocks that option - contact them for a custom link if so). +355 69 331 0183.

name: Conad - the last supermarket before Theth, 07:00-21:00
description: Everything for Theth and all three loop days - the LAST real supermarket. Carry ~2.3-4 kg of food for two, Wed breakfast to Fri lunch. Calories per gram: nuts, cured sausage, hard cheese, chocolate, olive oil, peanut butter. Bulk: pasta, couscous (hot water only), instant rice, instant mash. Breakfast: oats, powdered milk, honey, coffee sachets, tea bags. On the move: dried fruit, energy bars, salted nuts - Friday's descent burns as much as Wednesday's climb. Flavour: stock cubes, salt, tomato paste, garlic. Something sweet: local halva or Turkish delight. Nothing with water in it - no tins, no fresh veg beyond one onion. Bread from a bakery, fruit and veg from a stall or the bazaar. Conad is here for its position, not its price - Spar and Big Market are cheaper for the same goods. FILL THE TANK in Shkoder too: the last fuel station is at Koplik, nothing after the Theth turn-off and nothing in Theth (OSM, 12 Sep). Get lek here - OSM shows one ATM in Theth village, unverified.

name: Big Market - cheaper for the same goods
description: Everything for Theth and all three loop days - the LAST real supermarket. Carry ~2.3-4 kg of food for two, Wed breakfast to Fri lunch. Bread from a bakery, fruit and veg from a stall or the bazaar.

name: Thore pass viewpoint, 1,704 m
description: The high pass before the road drops into the Theth valley. A coffee shack, everyone stops, free, 15 min. Buni i Bajraktarit restaurant is just below the pass.

name: Camping Balcony - turn up, nothing booked (EUR 17 + 3 power)
description: Best rating in the valley: 4.93 from 97 on park4night, 5.0 from 254 on Google, no theft or safety complaint found. Spotless modern showers, hot water, the view over the whole valley, owners who give hiking advice. Open 1 Apr - 15 Nov. Costs: 15-20 min downhill to the village and back up, a steep narrow entrance, reports of intermittent electricity and hot water, and no review names a dinner. IF FULL: Guesthouse Pashko or Zariklis (tabs). The car parks here for the loop, ~EUR 3.5/night.
facilities: modern showers, hot water, bar, breakfast EUR 6, power

name: Guesthouse Pashko - 0.5 km from the village, dinner 15, breakfast 5
description: A third of the walk. Dinner EUR 15, breakfast 5, book ahead. 'Stunning views, friendly owners, electricity and hot showers for EUR 10', and a short trail to a blue swimming hole right behind. Its one complaint is the wifi.

name: Zariklis - EUR 10, 500 m, family table
description: Breakfast and dinner eaten with the family - 'very tasty, home made'. 5 pitches, small vehicles only, and you share the bathroom with the owners.

name: Theth canyon loop - 10.7 km, 3h45, Grunas waterfall on the way
description: The real Theth walk, not the short 7.1 km version (that one only reaches the waterfall). The narrow gorge, the small bridge, the abseil hooks, Grunas waterfall on the way. Starts at the church in the village. Go for the canyon, treat the waterfall as the stop on the way. Fatigue matters: two Theth-Valbona hikers lost their main day to a side hike the day before - that is why Tuesday is easy.

name: Grunas waterfall - ice cold, busy in full sun
description: On the canyon loop, 45-50 min from the village - the stop on the way, not a destination. Water 'ice cold', 'nearly impossible' to stay in over 30 seconds, still busy at 18:00 in full sun.

name: Ura e Gerles - FISH at last light (the canyon bridge)
description: The wooden bridge on the canyon walk. Trout on dries at last light - water gin-clear and low, so they rise and refuse: technical, not easy (one fly-fisher spent three weeks here in Sept 2022 and landed zero). Other spots: Kolaj bridge, Gerla bridge, Nderlysa. No licence needed from the bank anywhere in Albania.

name: Theth church + the Lock-in Tower (kulla e ngujimit)
description: Next to each other in the middle of the village, free, 10 min. The kulla e ngujimit is where men under blood feud sat out their lives. Walk past on the way to dinner.

name: Dinner in Theth village
description: Any of the village places: Gjon Shpella and Restorant Zorgji (barbecue), I Harushave, a pizza place, a grill, Thethi Paradise. A main plus salad and a drink 1,000-1,200 lek. Then 15-20 min back up to Balcony.

name: Dawn FISH - Shala, Gerla bridge stretch
description: Walk from the tent to Ura e Gerles or the Gerla bridge below the Gerla guesthouses. First light 05:54, sunrise 06:20. The other prime window and nothing competes for it - the only cost is getting up. Breakfast at the camp after.

name: Park at Nderlysaj for the Blue Eye
description: 6 km / 10-15 min down the valley. Park 200 lek, or free further out. Camping Nderlysaj BJ and Franc's Camping are here (4.8 on park4night, river swimming, campfires) - the alternative base if Balcony disappoints.

name: Blue Eye (Syri i Kalter) - 40 min uphill in, swim, 30 min out
description: Drive in from Nderlysaj - do not hike it from Theth, the drive-in is the point. ~6.4 km round trip. Entry ~50 lek, CASH ONLY; sources disagree on whether entry is charged at all.

name: Shala pool, Nderlysaj (Vaskat)
description: The lower of the two Shala swimming pools, right by Nderlysaj. No climbing today - this is the buffer before three loaded days.

name: Lunch in Theth village
description: Back up the valley. Any village place; 1,000-1,200 lek a head.

name: Shala pool below Theth - swim, repack
description: The upper pool, on the road down the valley. Swim, then repack for the loop this afternoon.

name: Last-light FISH - village stretch
description: Last light on the stretch by the village (Rupa camping is on the bank here). Or Nderlysa (tab) if Monday fished badly.

name: Nderlysa - bigger water, if Monday fished badly
description: Same river 6 km down-valley, bigger water. Narrow paved road, 15 min, fine in the dark taken slowly.

name: Gjon Shpella - order flija
description: Sit-down dinner. ORDER FLIJA - hours of prep, a honeycomb of layers under a bell dome; the dish of these mountains. Also grilled trout, home-made yoghurt.

name: Villa Belinis - restaurant, milk from their own cows
description: Sit-down dinner. ORDER FLIJA - hours of prep, a honeycomb of layers under a bell dome; the dish of these mountains. Also grilled trout, home-made yoghurt. Fresh buttermilk and pancakes; nearest to Balcony.

name: Restorant Zorgji - barbecue
description: Sit-down dinner. ORDER FLIJA - hours of prep, a honeycomb of layers under a bell dome; the dish of these mountains. Also grilled trout, home-made yoghurt.

name: Balcony night 2 - tell them your route
description: Before Theth's signal runs out: download the offline map and cache the forecast (meteoblue, mountain-forecast). TELL THE OWNERS YOUR ROUTE AND YOUR RETURN DAY (Fri 18) - there is no mountain rescue in this range, that is the actual safety net; 112 works nationally. ASK WHICH SPRINGS ARE RUNNING, by name: Sheu i Bardhe, Gropat e Bukura, Peja - shepherds are up there all summer and know more than any page. Park the car here, ~EUR 3.5/night. Vodafone does better than One in the mountains (guide consensus, not a coverage map).

name: Loop start at Balcony - 10.1 km, +1,078 m today
description: Fill 2 L each before you go (the campsite tap). THE ROUTE: 27.8 km, +2,183 m over three days, both camps in it (komoot tour). Today 10.1 km, +1,078 m, 825 -> 1,673 m - the hard day; the 'alpine' rating is this Peja climb, not the Valbona side. Away by 07:00. Start each day with 2 L each. ~3,100 kcal for you, ~2,250 for her today. No signal on the route, both nights included.

name: Km 4.5-5.8 Shtraza springs - unseen
description: On the climb. On the map and nothing more - nobody has seen these run. Shtraza meadow at km 7.1 (42.44027, 19.76246).

name: Km 8.4 Peja Lake - assume dry
description: Spring 57 m off and the lake 24 m off, both tagged intermittent; an Oct 2025 review said almost no water. This is the close pass, before camp - you will see for yourself. Nice to be wrong. Qafa e Pejes, 1,742 m, is just above (42.44387, 19.77062); an old bunker 200 m from the lake.

name: NIGHT 1: White Spring camp, km 10.1, 1,673 m
description: Your komoot find: 5.0 from 4 ratings, photos of a tent on flat grass, 2-3 tents. Holger, July 2025: 'A good place to camp just before the Peja Pass, in a valley with a meadow. Water is also available.' The only water on the route anyone has actually seen. In camp early afternoon; a long cold evening at 1,673 m (4-7 C tonight). PITCH FOR DRAINAGE, not just for flat - severe afternoon thunderstorms were logged here in late August. Inside the national park: gas stove fine, no fire. Former military post 30 m away, an observation bunker 160 m, dry-stone shepherd walls 300 m south. Maja e Harapit 2,218 m ('the Matterhorn of Albania') to the west - a demanding alpine path, not for today. NOT SURE ABOUT THURSDAY'S SPRING? Fill 8 L here and carry it 3.9 km further - heavy morning, no gamble.
facilities: spring 16 m from the pitch (Burimi Sheu i Bardhe) plus a ford 36 m; nearest building 1.3 km

name: Km 14 spring - FILL 8 L, last water
description: 6 m off the line, the last water before the high camp. NOBODY HAS CONFIRMED IT RUNS - the whole high camp depends on it (a Sept 2026 report filtered from a shepherd's wooden box on the Qafa e Pejes plateau, not confirmed as this spring). 8 litres for two: drinking, cooking, breakfast, and 1.5 L each for Friday morning to km 19.4. IF IT IS DRY: do not go up - camp here at Gropa e Bukur, or push over the pass to Burimet e Valbones (km 21.2). Decide here, with water in your hands. Then 2.2 km and +466 m carrying it. Today 6.1 km, +710 m.

name: NIGHT 2: high camp 2,206 m, km 16.2
description: Your own komoot find, properly wild: the most remote pitch on the loop, 1.7 km from the nearest building. Nothing here - no water within 2.1 km. Forecast 3-5 C and 0-10 mm on 2 of 3 models (Fri 11 check) - the day to plan around. THE THURSDAY CALL: only if Monday in Shkoder showed a real, agreed-on wet Thursday or Friday, skip this night and push over the Valbona pass to the meadow at km 21.5 (backup pin) - that trades the wildest night for a short wet Friday and no water gamble. As it stood on Fri 11: take the high camp. Sleeping bags good to ~4 C; a wet bag up here is the one failure with no recovery - dry bags inside the packs.
facilities: none - no water within 2.1 km; 8 L carried up from km 14

name: Meadow east of the Valbona pass, km 21.5, ~1,750 m - the wet-weather alternative to the high camp
description: If Thursday or Friday looks genuinely wet: Thursday becomes 11.4 km with the pass in it, Friday only 6.3 km down. Water at Burimet e Valbones 300 m away (fill and carry 900 m); toilets and two trail bars within 1.1 km. 818 m off the line, not wild. The last bail-outs if the high camp is wrong on the day: the pass itself (km 21.3, toilets, water, two trail bars) and this meadow.
facilities: Burimet e Valbones spring 300 m; toilets and trail bars within 1.1 km

name: Valbona pass 1,780 m, km 21.3 - then all down
description: Away 07:00. The climb to the pass comes first, km 19-21, then all down: 11.6 km, +400 m, -1,860 m today, ~3,150 kcal - Friday is not a rest day, do not under-pack it. Water: Burimet e Valbones 192 m from the pass (42.40774, 19.81665), springs at km 19.4, 23.0 and 26.3. Toilets and two trail bars within 1.1 km. Poles shortened for the descent, boots tighter at the ankle.

name: Theth: shower at Balcony, get the car
description: Theth ~12:00. Shower, pack the car, something to wear that is not hiking kit. The descent is what makes you sore, and it peaks 24-48 h later - Saturday morning, not tonight.

name: Albanian Art flat, Tirana - shower and nap
description: BOOKED 2026-08-30, EUR 65, Fri 18 -> Sat 19. The Airbnb pin is approximate - the exact spot is in the booking. 172 km, ~4.1 h from Theth. ONLINE CHECK-IN FOR THE FLIGHT HOME OPENS 13:50 TODAY - do it from the flat this evening or Ryanair charges you at the airport. Out for the whole evening from 19:30. PARKING: the listing names no parking at all (checked 12 Sep) - ask the host where to leave the car before Friday, or plan a paid garage nearby.

name: Pyramid of Tirana - climb the outside steps, lit up
description: Free. Do it tonight, lit up. If the steps are closed after dark it is 600 m from the flat and costs nothing to walk past.

name: Pazari i Ri - the food quarter, walk in
description: The default: walk into the food quarter, 600 m from the flat. Albanians eat 21:00-22:00. Byrek under EUR 1 anywhere; raki from a shop, not a bar. Something better: Oda or Mullixhiu (tabs), both take same-day online booking - decide from the flat after the nap.

name: Oda - tave kosi, garden; same-day online booking
description: Tave kosi (baked lamb and yoghurt) in a garden. Same-day online booking - decide from the flat after the nap.

name: Mullixhiu - tasting menu; same-day online booking
description: The tasting menu, by the Grand Park. Same-day online booking.

name: Nouvelle Vague, Blloku - #28 World's 50 Best Bars 2025
description: Blloku from 22:30. Sky Club, Radio Bar and Hemingway are the other tabs.

name: Sky Club, Sky Tower - the 360 view
description: Rooftop bar on the Sky Tower, the 360 view over the city.

name: Radio Bar, Blloku
description: Vintage radios, cocktails, Blloku.

name: Hemingway Bar
description: Rum and cigars, north of the centre.

name: Komiteti Kafe Muzeum - raki, to 00:00
description: Raki in a communist-era museum-cafe, open to 00:00. Then KINO (to 02:00), Tunel 180 m from the flat, or Magic Club (to 03:00) - tabs. Do not book anything you have to be upright for on Saturday.

name: KINO - to 02:00
description: Bar-club in Blloku, 08:00-02:00.

name: Tunel - music venue, 180 m from the flat
description: Live music and a terrace, the closest to the flat.

name: Magic Club - to 03:00
description: Club in Blloku, to 03:00.

name: Bunk'Art 2 - 500 m from the flat, Fri to 20:00
description: Cold-war interior ministry bunker turned museum of the secret police, right by Skanderbeg square. OSM hours: Mo-Th, Su 09:30-18:00; Fr, Sa 09:30-20:00 (not checked against the museum). Fits 19:00-19:45 between the nap and the Pyramid if you skip half the nap.

name: Coffee: Mulliri i Vjeter, Parku Rinia
description: Sleep as long as you want - nothing is planned today. Coffee by Parku Rinia, then the airport at 11:00.

name: Airport: return the car, bag drop by 13:10
description: 16 km / ~30 min from the flat, leave 11:00. Returning the car takes time too - budget it like the 40 min pickup; the booking ends 13:30. Bag drop closes 13:10, flight FR 6889 13:50 -> Vienna 15:30.
bestTime: leave the flat 11:00; bag drop closes 13:10

name: Rozafa Castle, Shkoder - the big one, 19 min from Shiroka
description: Shkoder's hilltop castle over the lake and the three rivers - the view is the point, an hour is enough. SH1 from Lezhe passes right below it entering Shkoder, so Sunday morning on the way to the Mesi bridge costs no detour (castle ~10:30, bridge ~11:45, canyon from ~12:15). Not in the plan; nobody checked hours or the fee (a few hundred lek reported).

name: Cape Rodon (Kepi i Rodonit) - Skanderbeg's castle on a sea cape. Too far for this trip
description: Ruins of Skanderbeg's castle on a cape into the Adriatic, beaches on both sides. Checked Sat 12 Sep: airport -> cape 78 min, cape -> Spar Lezhe 110 min, against 46 min direct - a 3.5 h detour on landing day, which is the rain day, and no other day passes within an hour. Keep for another trip (Durres side).

name: Dajti Ekspres cable car - only if you are up early Saturday
description: 15 min gondola from the east edge of Tirana up Mount Dajti, the view over the whole plain; Bunk'Art 1 is at the lower station. Sat 19 is a sleep-in day and the flat leaves at 11:00, so this only fits if you are awake by 08:30 - hours not checked, opens around 09:00 by most reports.
